name: Widths are scaled from the last zoom, as in 0.2.0
old:
scale = (level / zoom).toFloat()
        padding = basePadding * scale
        minimum = baseMinimum * scale
        maximum = baseMaximum * scale
        for (index in widths.indices) widths[index] = base[index] * scale
        rowNumberWidth = baseRowNumberWidth * scale
new:
val factor = (level / zoom).toFloat() / scale
        scale = (level / zoom).toFloat()
        padding *= factor
        minimum *= factor
        maximum *= factor
        for (index in widths.indices) widths[index] *= factor
        rowNumberWidth *= factor

name: The row number column is scaled from the last zoom
A column added while zoomed takes its zoomed width as its basis
old: for (index in base.size until count) grown[index] = widths[index] / scale
new: for (index in base.size until count) grown[index] = widths[index]

name: A zoom step drops the row views and makes new ones, as in 0.2.0
A row bound again keeps its old height
Columns made while zoomed think they are at 100%
